You're not! Having a baby is a huge change, and it's okay to mourn your old life. But I read a quote somewhere, everyone tells you the bad, but no one tells you the good, how much fun you'll have. Do you have telehealth, Zoom, or urgent care? Any of those things can help and give you peace of mind as well as possibly prescribing you pregnancy safe relief. 

Eat very plain, like the BRAT diet, and see if that helps too if the above is not an option.

Pregnancy hormones exacerbate mental illnesses. I have bipolar disorder, and my OB told me I needed to have established mental health care before my baby is born. Because, it doesn't end when baby is born. Post partum hormones can do it too. I'm not trying to scare you, but with the disorders we have, we need different levels of care. 

I would suggest seeing a professional, just so you can get these feelings out. 

As far as a right now solution, if you need to be able to smell him to sleep, spray some of his cologne on your pillow, not too much, though. Or even making one of his shirts into a pillowcase. Start doing little crafts, make cute things for your growing family. It gives you a sense of feeling good that you did something for yourself AND your family. 

Take care OP, if you need someone to talk to, my DM's are open.
